items.prompt: What remains uncertain after observing a displayed quote?

options.text: The snapshot has no usable information at all
options.why: It can describe interest under its stated feed/time contract.

options.text: Every requested size will execute at that price
options.why: Displayed quantity is limited and may change.

options.text: The quote is necessarily a completed trade
options.why: Quotes and executions are distinct records.

options.text: Its availability when the order arrives
options.why: Delay, competing flow and changes can alter accessible liquidity.

items.explanation: A visible quote is not a reservation or a guarantee of the user's execution.
